name: Artist & Mountain Lord
source:
A short visual novel inspired by Japanese folklore.

A traveling artist who wanders into a small village hears about this magnificent cherry blossom tree. Upon finding it, he encounters the lord of the mountain who cherishes his mountain and the cherry blossom tree. Then the mountain lord tells the artist his plan to...

The ending changes depending on what you choose to do, or not do.
Where do your choices lead you to...?

[From [url=https://q-yoneda.itch.io/artist-mountain-lord]Itch.io[/url]]
